expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card's '15–25 min' badge sits on top of the poké bowl plate and covers part of it. The badge's left offset also looks inconsistent with the other cards, where it sits clear of the dish.
The secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', '(500+)') and the search placeholder are light gray on white or light gray, giving low contrast.

The inactive bottom-nav labels (Search, Orders, Profile) and icons are low-contrast gray. The heart icon on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle over a busy image, which makes it hard to see.
The promo banner has decorative circles that look cut off and overlap unevenly at the right and bottom edges. The white text over the lighter green area on the right has reduced contrast.

expected.reasoning: None of the reported issues mention the Orders icon missing from the bottom navigation bar.
